query: SELECT TRUE AS "is_monitored_only!" FROM twitch_streamers s WHERE (($1 <> '' AND s.twitch_user_id = $1) OR ($2 <> '' AND LOWER(s.twitch_login) = $2)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM twitch_partners p WHERE p.twitch_user_id = s.twitch_user_id OR LOWER(p.twitch_login) = LOWER(s.twitch_login) ) LIMIT 1
